ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The waveform on the left is labeled x_1(t), and it is a rectangular pulse with amplitude 1 between t=-1 and t=1, and is 0 elsewhere. The waveform on the right is labeled x_2(t), and there is one unit impulse each at t=-1 and t=1; both impulses in the figure are labeled (1) beside them. Reasoning: Therefore it can be written as x_2(t)=δ(t+1)+δ(t-1). Using the impulse shift property of convolution, x(t)=x_1(t)*x_2(t)=x_1(t)*[δ(t+1)+δ(t-1)]=x_1(t+1)+x_1(t-1). Among them, the nonzero interval of x_1(t+1) is from -2 to 0, and the nonzero interval of x_1(t-1) is from 0 to 2; after ignoring the endpoint value convention, the two together give a unit rectangular pulse from t=-2 to t=2. So x(t)=u(t+2)-u(t-2).

raw_record.question_text: Given that the waveforms of the signals \(x_1(t)\) and \(x_2(t)\) are as shown in the image, what is the expression for \(x(t)=x_1(t)*x_2(t)\)?

method.method_draft: First identify the waveforms from the image: x1 is a unit rectangular pulse spanning t=-1 to t=1, and x2 is the sum of two unit impulses at t=-1 and t=1. Apply the impulse convolution shift rule to write x(t)=x1(t+1)+x1(t-1). Convert the resulting support into a step expression: the sum is 1 from t=-2 to t=2, so x(t)=u(t+2)-u(t-2), ignoring endpoint convention details.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左侧波形标为 x_1(t)，它是在 t=-1 到 t=1 之间幅值为 1 的矩形脉冲，其余为 0。右侧波形标为 x_2(t)，在 t=-1 和 t=1 处各有一个单位冲激，图中两个冲激旁均标注为 (1)。推理：因此可写为 x_2(t)=δ(t+1)+δ(t-1)。利用卷积的冲激平移性质，x(t)=x_1(t)*x_2(t)=x_1(t)*[δ(t+1)+δ(t-1)]=x_1(t+1)+x_1(t-1)。其中 x_1(t+1) 的非零区间为 -2 到 0，x_1(t-1) 的非零区间为 0 到 2；忽略端点取值约定后，两者合起来得到从 t=-2 到 t=2 的单位矩形脉冲。所以 x(t)=u(t+2)-u(t-2)。

method.method_draft: After extracting the two signals from the plots, compute their Fourier transforms: X1(ω)=∫_{-1}^{1}e^{-jωt}dt=2sinω/ω and X2(ω)=e^{jω}+e^{-jω}=2cosω.
